capture_source: live captures 2026-11-12: the reference client (pyrfc 3.3.1 on the NW RFC SDK 7.50) calling Z_SAPRFCLIB_TYPES, a purpose-built remote-enabled function module (local object on an S/4HANA ABAP system, kernel 793) that echoes INT8, UTCLONG, DATN and TIMN importing parameters and returns fixed values. Its metadata (RFC_GET_FUNCTION_INTERFACE) reports EXID '8' with 8 bytes for INT8 and 'p' with 8 bytes for UTCLONG.
source_of_values: the values are what the reference client was given (requests, dir C>S) or returned to the caller (replies, dir S>C); the reference client refused 1582-10-10 (calendar gap) and '2026-11-12 10:21:26' (format).
evidence: tier 1 live capture; every value also round-trips through the function module and back.

datn_timn.note: DATN and TIMN travel as DATE and TIME: UTF-16LE YYYYMMDD / HHMMSS.
